2026 CADILLAC ESCALADE V

SUPERCHARGED V8, ARGENT SILVER, EXECUTIVE SECOND ROW SEATING, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2026 Cadillac Escalade-V takes America's flagship luxury SUV and adds supercharged performance worthy of its towering presence. Under the hood lies a hand-built 6.2-liter supercharged V8, producing 682 horsepower and 653 lb-ft of torque. Mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission and performance-tuned all-wheel drive, this full-size luxury SUV delivers blistering acceleration, with 0-60 mph in just 4.4 seconds––sports car figures in a three-row SUV. A performance exhaust system provides a thunderous soundtrack that's as commanding as the vehicle itself. Magnetic Ride Control and adaptive air suspension keep the Escalade-V composed, offering both comfort and athleticism. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

description:
Theres a velvet kind of authority to the 2022 MercedesBenz EClass E 450 the sort of presence that arrives like a welltimed jazz solo: confident, composed and impossible to ignore without seeming loud. From the curb it doesnt shout, it conducts. The silhouette is graceful yet purposeful, long bonnet lines melting into a poised cabin, and surfaces that play with light in a way that makes the car look as if its perpetually poised to move. Its elegance with an undercurrent of intent the sort of sedan that makes a driveway feel like a stage.

Climb inside and the theater becomes tactile. The cabin wraps you in refined materials and quiet geometry: seats that hug just enough to feel composed, surfaces that invite your hand, and ambient lighting that flatters rather than flaunts. The dash is an exercise in modern restraint screens and knobs integrated like discreet assistants leaving space for the cars real gift: an atmosphere that balances ceremony with comfort. Details matter here: stitching that reads like punctuation, metal trim that catches the eye, and a sense of finish that rewards familiarity.

On the road the E 450 is a masterclass in conversational driving. It doesnt demand your attention so much as earn it. Acceleration isnt a parade its a persuasive argument, smooth and sure, turning highway passes into satisfying asides. The chassis moves with an athletes poise: body control that reassures, steering that feels precise without being hyperactive, and a suspension that politely translates the world into composure. This is a car that keeps you invited to drive, without ever insisting on drama.

Sound plays its part like a soundtrack edited for taste: a low, cultured voice that swells when coaxed and retreats when you prefer calm. The cabins hush lets conversation and music breathe, turning long runs into moments rather than chores. Practical comforts are integrated with the same thoughtful hand room enough for lifes errands, storage that behaves, and ergonomics that make daily routines feel a little more civilized.

In short, the 2022 EClass E 450 is refinement with a pulse: luxurious without pretense, alert without aggression, and always ready to turn ordinary miles into something subtly memorable. Its a sedan for people who like their luxury to arrive with manners and a wink.
